cases.sentence: В десятом году, в двенадцатый день десятого ___, было ко мне слово Господа.
cases.translation: In the tenth year, on the twelfth day of the tenth month, the word of the Lord came to me.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used for the day within a month: 'день месяца' (day of the month).

cases.sentence: Сын человеческий, обрати лицо к фараону, царю ___, и пророчествуй против него.
cases.translation: Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him.
cases.explain: The phrase 'царю Египта' uses the genitive to show that Pharaoh is the king of Egypt.

cases.sentence: Я твой враг, фараон, царь Египта, чудовищный ___, что в реках своих разлегся.
cases.translation: I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the rivers.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative after the implied verb 'you are' requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я продену крюк в твои челюсти и рыбу из рек твоих приклею к твоей ___.
cases.translation: I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales.
cases.explain: The verb 'приклею' (I will stick) with indirect object 'scales' takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я брошу тебя в пустыню, тебя и рыбу из твоих ___.
cases.translation: I will cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish from your rivers.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) requires the genitive case: 'из рек' (from rivers).

cases.sentence: Я отдам тебя в пищу земному зверю и небесным ___.
cases.translation: I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the heavens.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в пищу' (as food) governing the dative 'птицам' shows the recipient of the action.

cases.sentence: Ты был посохом и страстника для дома ___.
cases.translation: You were a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
cases.explain: The phrase 'дома Израиля' uses the genitive to show possession: the house of Israel.

cases.sentence: По прошествии сорока лет я соберу египтян из народов, среди которых они были рассеяны. Я восстановлю и возвращу их в Верхний Египет, землю их ___, они будут там слабым царством.
cases.translation: After forty years, I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered and restore them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestors; they will be a lowly kingdom there.
cases.explain: The phrase 'землю их предков' uses the genitive plural 'предков' to show possession: land of their ancestors.

reading.ru: Я твой враг, фараон, царь Египта, чудовищный крокодил, что в реках своих разлегся.
reading.question: How does God describe himself in relation to the Pharaoh?
options: God says he is against Pharaoh and compares him to a great monster lying in his rivers
God says he will help Pharaoh become stronger
God says he will establish Pharaoh's kingdom
God says he needs Pharaoh's advice
reading.correct: God says he is against Pharaoh and compares him to a great monster lying in his rivers
reading.explain: God declares: 'Я твой враг, фараон... чудовищный крокодил, что в реках своих разлегся' — I am your enemy, Pharaoh... the great monster lying in your rivers.

reading.ru: Нил мой, — говоришь ты, — я для себя его создал.
reading.question: What arrogant claim does Pharaoh make about the Nile?
options: He claims the Nile is his and that he created it for himself
He claims he discovered the Nile
He claims he can control the Nile's floods
He claims he will dry up the Nile
reading.correct: He claims the Nile is his and that he created it for himself
reading.explain: Pharaoh boasts: 'Нил мой... я для себя его создал' — The Nile is mine, I created it for myself.

reading.ru: Ты был посохом и страстника для дома Израиля. Когда они брались за тебя, ты расщеплялся и ранил им плечи.
reading.question: What does God say Egypt was to Israel?
options: A staff that broke and wounded them when they relied on it
A source of great strength and protection
A faithful ally in times of trouble
A provider of food and resources
reading.correct: A staff that broke and wounded them when they relied on it
reading.explain: God describes Egypt as harmful: 'Ты был посохом и страстника для дома Израиля... ты расщеплялся и ранил им плечи' — when they grasped you, you broke and wounded their shoulders.

reading.ru: Я сделаю землю Египта мертвой пустыней от Мегдола до Сиены, до самой границы с Кушем.
reading.question: What will God do to the land of Egypt?
options: Make it a desolate wilderness from Migdol to Aswan, to the border of Cush
Make it a center of worship
Turn it into a great sea
reading.correct: Make it a desolate wilderness from Migdol to Aswan, to the border of Cush
reading.explain: God's judgment: 'Я сделаю землю Египта мертвой пустыней от Мегдола до Сиены, до самой границы с Кушем' — I will make Egypt a desolate wilderness from Migdol to Aswan, to Cush's border.

reading.ru: По прошествии сорока лет я соберу египтян из народов, среди которых они были рассеяны.
reading.question: What will God do for Egypt after forty years?
options: He will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered
He will make Egypt more powerful than before
He will hand Egypt over to Babylon
reading.correct: He will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered
reading.explain: God promises restoration: 'По прошествии сорока лет я соберу египтян из народов, среди которых они были рассеяны' — After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.

reading.ru: Я восстановлю и возвращу их в Верхний Египет, землю их предков, они будут там слабым царством, самым слабым из царств, и никогда впредь не возвысятся над другими народами.
reading.question: What kind of kingdom will Egypt be when it is restored?
options: A lowly kingdom, the weakest of kingdoms, and never again will it rise above other nations
The greatest power in the world
A united kingdom under one strong ruler
A source of wisdom for all nations
reading.correct: A lowly kingdom, the weakest of kingdoms, and never again will it rise above other nations
reading.explain: God's restoration includes humiliation: 'они будут там слабым царством, самым слабым из царств, и никогда впредь не возвысятся' — they will be a lowly kingdom, the weakest of kingdoms, never again to rise above other nations.
